messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Main Anti Corruption Officer Shahid bol raha hoon, badge number AC-2291.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Aap ke ilaqay ke contractor par case hai aur aap gawah hain, official record mein naam aap ka aya hai.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Gawah? Maine kuch dekha hi nahi.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Record correction ke liye verification officer ID card number bhejo apna, case file update karne hai.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: ID number sensitive hota hai main khud office aa kar de deta hoon.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Office aane ka time nahi hai. Turant photo bhejo warna summon nikal jaye ga, criminal case ban jaye ga.
